title: Immune-Regulating Lipid Signals May Provide a Path to Treat Chronic Inflammation
summary: By inhibiting the enzyme sEH and boosting epoxy-oxylinpins levels, scientists have shown that it is possible to lower levels of specific immune cells linked to chronic inflammation.The postImmune-Regulating Lipid Signals May Provide a Path to Treat Chronic Inflammationappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
